title: An independent plan checker
heading: Trap Questions: Quick Answers That Are Wrong
cases: a plan within every rule breaks nothing, and one over the budget breaks the budget
a plan with both projects of a conflicting pair breaks that conflict
a project that is needed may be funded alone, and one that needs it may not
a region with exactly its cap of projects breaks nothing
a plan that breaks several rules reports all of them
a region missing from the caps has no cap, and a region with a cap still has one
